messages:
ops-comm: quick sync — proposing updates to our internal incident comms templates and the wording library. goal: clearer handoffs, consistent customer-facing tone, and faster status page updates. want feedback before i iterate on the doc.

incident-bot: [AUTO] New pager triggered: P1 inference-latency spike — assigned to @sre-oncall. Link: https://infra.redwood/status/1762005429 (react :rotating_light:)

ops-comm: fyi that auto-pager is the reason i'm pushing this now. during noisy P1s we're seeing inconsistent messages across on-call and product. we need a minimal set of sections that everyone can copy/paste.

maria: +1. can we make the customer-facing copy more empathetic and less technical by default? engineers tend to over-explain.

devon: agreed. proposal: two canonical templates — "internal" (detailed, timeline, mitigations, owner, runbook refs) and "external" (short, impact, ETA, next steps, what customers should do). include placeholders.

sre-oncall: also add a short on-call handoff blurb — what to include when escalating to next shift. last thing we need during a swap is missing context.

ops-comm: below mockups. please shout if this format will block anything. i kept them compact.

ops-comm: [INTERNAL TEMPLATE]
```
INCIDENT ID: {{incident_id}}
SEVERITY: {{severity}} (P1/P2)
REPORTER: {{reporter}}
CURRENT STATUS: {{investigating/identified/mitigating/resolved}}
IMPACT SUMMARY: short 1-2 lines
AFFECTED SCOPE: {{services/customers/regions}}
TIMELINE:
  - {{t0}}: alert triggered
  - {{t1}}: mitigation started
  - {{t2}}: mitigation next step
OWNER: {{primary_oncall}} + backup {{oncall_backup}}
MITIGATION STEPS TAKEN: bullet list with commands/runbook refs
NEXT ACTIONS: who is owning what (including customer comms)
COMMUNICATIONS: links to status page / customer message drafts
POSTMORTEM OWNER: {{pm_owner}}
```

ops-comm: [EXTERNAL TEMPLATE — STATUS PAGE / CUSTOMER EMAIL]
```
SUBJECT: Incident {{incident_id}} — partial service degradation (short)
STATUS: Investigating / Mitigating / Resolved
SUMMARY: We are currently experiencing {{brief impact description}} affecting {{scope}}.

WHAT WE'RE DOING: Our team is actively investigating and has taken initial mitigation steps. We will provide updates every {{update_interval}} or as the situation changes.

POTENTIAL WORKAROUNDS: {{if applicable}}
EXPECTED NEXT UPDATE: {{ETA or timeframe}}
CONTACT: support@redwood.ai (for urgent customer impact please include account id)
```

maria: i like the external one. tiny suggestion: change "What we're doing" -> "What we're doing to help" and add a one-sentence apology opener. makes it feel less robotic.

ops-comm: updated the line. new external starts with: "We're sorry for the disruption — we know this impacts your work." short and direct.

nina: can we add a small "status severity explanation" snippet for product folks who need to translate P1->customer-impact? e.g., P1 = outage or major degradation affecting many customers.

devon: yep. add a quick mapping in the internal template: P1/P2 definitions and recommended external tone per severity. also include a "Do not include" list for customer comms (internal runbook details, specific debug commands, stack traces).

ops-comm: good call. here's the on-call handoff checklist I want to standardize (short):
```
ON-CALL HANDOFF (2-3 bullets max)
- Current incident ID and severity
- Summary of actions performed (what worked/what didn't)
- Pending actions and owners
- Links: runbook, status page, customer draft
- Any required approvals (legal/comms) before external blast
```

legal: quick note — for external emails, avoid language that admits liability. stick with neutral factual wording + apology. we can pre-clear a short library of approved phrases.

product-ops: thumbs up. i'll take ownership of updating the status page templates with these sections and adding the severity-to-tone map. ops-comm can you make a PR to docs with the canonical templates?

ops-comm: i'll open the PR after we land final wording here. request: please add two reviewers: @product-ops and @legal.

sre-oncall: one more ops detail — include an explicit line in internal template for "customer notification owner" so someone is accountable to hit send.

ops-comm: added that.

devon: proposed short phrases for external template — we should standardize these snippets as a dropdown in the status page editor:
- "We're investigating reports of increased latency affecting text generation in the US region."
- "We are mitigating a partial degradation affecting embeddings jobs; some requests may fail or be slower than usual."
- "Service restored. We are monitoring and will follow up with a post-incident summary."

maria: also add a quick "How to escalate to enterprise" note — include CSM/AE mention and SLA link. large customers expect a contact path.

ops-comm: added escalation path placeholder in external template. final asks before i PR: 1) sign off on the apology wording, 2) agree on 15-min min update cadence for P1s, 3) confirm legal-approved neutral phrases list.

legal: we can pre-approve 6 neutral snippets. i'll drop them in the PR review.

product-ops: 15-min cadence is fine. product will maintain the dropdown snippets.

maria: sign off on apology wording + empathy tweak.

devon: sign off on templates + handoff checklist. i'll add runbook references when i PR.

ops-comm: thanks all. i'll make the PR and tag reviewers. leaving a pinned copy in #incidents once merged. if someone wants different phrasing for specific customers, add a snippet to the library and flag legal.

incident-bot: [AUTO] Reminder: update this incident thread with official status page link when available (react :link:).

ops-comm: end of thread — small follow up: if anyone wants to practice a customer readout voice, ping me and i'll run a 10-min tabletop next week.
